categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the comprehensive stone industry, including quarrying raw stone, processing stone into architectural and craft products, distributing and selling processed stone materials, and providing stone construction services. Its business segments cover quarrying (primary industry), stone processing (secondary industry), stone sales and trade (tertiary industry), and stone construction services (construction industry).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes natural stone quarrying from its own quarry in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, and outsources stone processing such as cutting and precision processing to external subcontractors located in its logistics center in Icheon. It employs advanced methods like wire saw technology to reduce noise and dust during blasting, ensuring environmentally friendly quarrying and high-quality stone processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large construction companies and public sector clients engaged in building high-end architectural projects requiring durable and aesthetically natural stone materials. The company targets the domestic market for architectural interior and exterior stone materials and stone construction services, with sales conducted through multiple regional sales offices across South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with its headquarters in Seoul and multiple sales branches located in key regions including Icheon, Pocheon, Gwangju, Daegu, Busan, and Seoul Gangnam. Its quarry and processing facilities are concentrated in Gyeonggi Province, particularly in Pocheon and Icheon.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the supply chain: upstream in quarrying raw stone, midstream in stone processing and manufacturing, and downstream in distribution, sales, and stone construction services. It integrates raw material extraction, processing, sales, and construction, positioning itself as a vertically integrated player in the stone industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing new stone types to create high value-added products, securing competitive advantages by partnering with superior external processing firms, and expanding sales networks nationwide to capture regional stone markets. The company emphasizes continuous cost reduction, operational efficiency improvements, and strengthening core business capabilities in stone distribution and construction services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of processed stone products and architectural stone materials, stone construction service contracts, and rental income from leasing yards and exhibition spaces. The sales mix is approximately 62% from stone construction services and 38% from stone product manufacturing and distribution, with a minor portion from rental income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few comprehensive stone companies in South Korea capable of managing the entire value chain from quarrying to construction. While many competitors are small-scale and regionally focused, the company positions itself as a leading integrated stone industry player with a nationwide sales network and strong construction service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company recorded approximately 101.2 billion KRW in revenue with an operating profit of 4.6 billion KRW and net profit of 1.66 billion KRW. Although revenue decreased from the previous year, operating profit increased by about 18%, reflecting improved cost control and operational efficiency. The company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-equity ratio of 72.55% and total assets nearing 98.3 billion KRW.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive industry integration, enabling control over quality and supply from quarrying to final construction. It differentiates through high-quality, durable natural stone products tailored for premium architectural applications, supported by advanced processing technologies and a broad nationwide sales and service network. Its focus on cost competitiveness and high-value product development further strengthens its market leadership.
